tickets.message: My laptop is connected to Wi-Fi but I can't access any websites. Teams isn't working either. I have a client call in 20 minutes.
tickets.notes: Sufficient evidence: Wi-Fi connected + multiple apps failing + explicit deadline. Should get a direct diagnostic recommendation, not a follow-up question.

tickets.message: I changed my password this morning. I can log into my laptop but Outlook keeps asking me for my password.
tickets.notes: Sufficient evidence: password change correlates directly with a single app's auth failure -- classic cached-credential pattern.

tickets.message: My laptop has become extremely slow since this morning. I only have Chrome, Outlook and Teams open.
tickets.notes: Sufficient evidence for a first diagnostic step (check resource usage), even though root cause is still unknown -- the recommendation is a diagnostic step, not a diagnosis.

tickets.message: Nothing is connecting since I changed my password.
tickets.notes: Ambiguous: 'nothing is connecting' could mean Wi-Fi, VPN, or specific apps. Must ask which, not guess.
The headline case: single vague sentence, no scope, no device info. Must not produce a confident diagnosis.
